blocks.rationale: Adds a compact airline terminal helper that avoids the repeatedly unresolved multi-scalar fee schedule. One current-source reader produces a flat, aligned record of each checked bag's complete charge after cabin allocation and fee-table application; the deterministic helper adds those charges to the ticket price.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What integer ticket price is stated in the current facts?

inputs.name: checked_bag_charges
inputs.question: After allocating at most one qualifying personal item and one qualifying carry-on, what flat integer array gives each remaining checked bag's complete charge in checked-bag order, including its applicable ordinal base fee plus only the higher applicable oversize or overweight fee?

skill.intent: Compute the exact integer ticket-plus-fees total from the current ticket price and aligned complete charges for all bags that must be checked.

outputs.description: The exact integer ticket price plus the complete charges for every current checked bag.
outputs.name: answer
